title: IGPN investigates hand injury of protester during Toulouse clashes
seoTitle: Toulouse IGPN probe into protester injury

tea.why: Demonstrations took place across France regarding purchasing power and the defense of public services.
tea.want: Demands relating to purchasing power and public services as stated in reports.
tea.changed: Oct 28, 2026: The Toulouse prosecutor announced that the IGPN was tasked with investigating a protester's serious hand injury.

summary: In Toulouse, clashes occurred between protesters and law enforcement during demonstrations concerning purchasing power and public services. A 20-year-old protester suffered a severe hand injury during the events on October 24. Following a formal complaint lodged by the injured individual during a preliminary hearing, the Toulouse public prosecutor's office referred the case to the National Police General Inspectorate (IGPN) on Monday. The investigation was opened under the classification of intentional violence by a person holding public authority resulting in mutilation or permanent disability during a public demonstration. According to statements from the Minister of the Interior, nationwide demonstrations on that Saturday resulted in numerous arrests and injuries among both security forces and participants, including three protesters who sustained severe injuries across Toulouse, Reims, and Clermont-Ferrand.
response: According to the Interior Minister, 1,435 individuals were arrested nationwide during the demonstrations. The Toulouse prosecutor's office referred the protester's injury case to the IGPN for investigation following a formal complaint.

arrests.text: 1.435 personnes ont été interpellées en marge des manifestations

updates.text: Clashes occurred between protesters and law enforcement in Toulouse, resulting in a protester sustaining a severe hand injury.
The Toulouse prosecutor announced that the IGPN was officially assigned to investigate the protester's injury.
